explanation.text: The Logic: Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) collect funds from sophisticated investors and the workbook prescribes a minimum investment value of Rs. 1 crore per investor in an AIF. The Trap: Rs. 25 lakh and Rs. 10 lakh are too low for AIFs; Rs. 5 crore overstates the standard threshold. The Rs. 1 crore figure is the headline AIF investor minimum. Note: AIFs are positioned as products for sophisticated/HNI investors, so the high minimum is part of the product's eligibility design rather than a marketing decision by individual managers.
